about: Stack-pointer corrections for the IDB (Alt+K in IDA; pipeline/ida_apply_names.apply_sp pushes them): the real SP change of an instruction where IDA's own analysis is wrong, found by pipeline/ida_sp_check.py. After applying, re-export the function; its hx_patches entry then becomes stale and is dropped.

0x100C6693.why: call [eax+318h] (CXiSkeletonActor slot 0x318 = 0x100A4A10, ret): pops nothing; IDA took the preceding push ebp/push edi as arguments

0x100C7902.why: call [eax+3C8h] (slot 0x3C8 = 0x100CFAD0, ret 4): pops its one argument; IDA counted 0
